title: Four payroll providers for twenty people in two states
variant: Transposed: options as rows with a summary column
prompt: Compare four payroll providers for a 20-person company in two states.
note: Transposed, with providers as rows and seven attributes as columns, because four options with a sentence each read better as a scan-down list than as a wide grid; the summary column at the right is the row read for you, plain-toned so it never competes with the cells. A serif title, wide vertical spacing, and no photos, since payroll is software and the page's authority should come from the whitespace and the footnotes rather than from pictures; the best mark reads down a column, and the two quote-based prices are labeled as quotes in the cell and in the legend.
